items.name: Motorcycle Federation of Japan (MFJ) — 一般財団法人日本モーターサイクルスポーツ協会
items.notes: FIM affiliate; governs motorcycle sport in Japan including the All Japan Road Race Championship (JSB1000, ST1000, ST600, J-GP3, JP-SPORT).

items.name: JRR — All Japan Road Race official portal
items.notes: Official 全日本ロードレース portal (calendar, results, rider news) for the MFJ All Japan Road Race Championship. Replaces the weakly sourced JAR (jar.co.jp) promoter entry.
